operating_notes.text: Partnered with University of Cambridge to establish Rare Earth Supply Chain Observatory with a £600,000 investment over two years.
FY26 dividend payout was ₹302.10 Cr, about 30% of standalone PAT of ₹990.81 Cr, which included a ₹522.65 Cr input tax credit gain.
Dividends to the Government of Gujarat over FY22–FY26 total more than ₹1,050 Cr.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹814.05 Cr (+3.5% YoY), net profit ₹194.09 Cr (-14.2% YoY).
GMDC partnered with the University of Cambridge to establish India's first AI-powered Rare Earth Supply Chain Observatory.
2026-10-21: Presented a ₹223.55 Cr dividend cheque to the Government of Gujarat, its 74% shareholder, part of a ₹302.10 Cr FY26 final dividend of ₹9.50 per share.

status_history.evidence: Shareholders approved the ₹9.50 per share final dividend at the 63rd AGM held on September 30, 2026.
